8sux:
The Master of Professional Studies in Informatics equips students to succeed in the fast-growing and dynamic field of informatics.

In today’s technology-driven information economy, informatics—the study of how humans interact with information—has applications across a variety of industries, including healthcare, consulting, education, finance, manufacturing, and communications. Informatics professionals apply technical expertise to a wide range of challenges, from designing decision support systems and developing 3D visualizations to creating mobile applications and managing information and communication technologies, with attention to usability, reliability, privacy, safety, and security.

The program prepares IT professionals for management roles by connecting computing skills and applications to real-world issues in information strategy, data governance, ethics, and business intelligence.

The program offers both online and on-campus formats, providing flexibility for working professionals and international students seeking to advance in information technology and management. It attracts students from diverse educational backgrounds and emphasizes experiential learning, giving participants the opportunity to work on real-world business projects. As a STEM-designated graduate degree, it also allows international students to qualify for an extended period of Optional Practical Training (OPT).
1got: Northeastern University’s Master of Science in Bioinformatics provides cross-disciplinary training in biology, computer science, and data analytics—along with real-world experience. The program prepares graduates to play pivotal roles in today’s cutting-edge life science, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical industries focused on genomics, proteomics, personalized medicine, drug discovery, and cancer therapy.
7bdq:
This innovative, non-thesis graduate degree program combines advanced interdisciplinary training in biology, chemistry, chemical engineering, and pharmaceutical science with training in the high-value business skills critical to success in today’s dynamic workplace. Graduates are prepared to innovate, collaborate, and lead as research, managerial, or technical professionals in a wide range of biotechnology specialities. Our faculty members bring extensive experience and first-hand knowledge of industry trends, assuring that the program curriculum remains current and relevant.

Students have the option to specialize within one area of concentration (Biopharmaceutical Analytical Sciences, Biotech Enterprise, Molecular Biotechnology) take key courses from a range of concentrations, or no specialization. All options feature co-op work experience (optional).
8k4m:
Northeastern University in Toronto's Master of Science in Cyber-Physical Systems with a concentration in Internet of Things (IoT) prepares the graduates for a world of connected devices.

The program integrates the study of wireless networking, protocols, sensor networks, security, software development, embedded systems, data analytics, and Big Data to provide students with the knowledge and tools to develop IoT applications; analyze and design IoT architectures for different application domains; and develop data analytic tools to analyze the large amounts of data generated by the massive deployment of IoT devices.

Students learn and develop field-wide skills in networking and communications, embedded systems, data analytics, software development, cloud and edge computing, digital twins, and management of Big Data. They develop a deep understanding of IoT technologies, standards, topologies, architectures, and solutions for different domains.
8k4j:
The Master of Science in Data Analytics Engineering provides the knowledge and skills to improve products, processes, systems, and enterprises through data mining, data management, machine learning, and visualization.

Building on their engineering or science background, students will develop expertise in the analysis and optimization of data to solve problems and support decision making. They will gain rigorous analytical skills and research experience through technically advanced core courses in operations research, statistics, data mining, database management, and visualization, while specializing their degree with flexible electives from across Northeastern’s colleges. Some elective courses include Big Data, smart manufacturing, machine learning, business or healthcare analytics, network science, and Internet of Things. They’ll be prepared to take on a data analyst position in any industry or enter a doctoral program in areas including engineering healthcare, business, finance, security, or sustainability.
8k4k:
Northeastern in Toronto's Master of Science in Information Systems closes the gap between business management, software engineering, and information technology to help students improve processes and solve complex challenges related to business and society.

Throughout the program, students will engage in a broad, deep, and innovative curriculum that prepares them to become a problem-solver who designs groundbreaking software solutions that meet business-world complexities and the humanistic needs of users. They'll also gain the interpersonal skills needed to succeed across industries.

Courses are interactive, conversational, and participatory. They'll take ownership of their learning experience through technical sessions and discussions of real-world cases.
7aqc:
The Doctor of Pharmacy/Masters in Public Health (PharmD/MPH) dual degree enables students to broaden the scope of their pharmacy training to include a public health perspective. Direct-Entry students can graduate with both a PharmD and MPH degree in just 5 years, saving one full year of study.

Students enrolled in the joint Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD)/Master of Public Health (MPH) Program have the opportunity to take graduate courses in the MPH Program while earning their PharmD.
8jj5:
The Graduate Certificate in Blockchain and Smart Contract Engineering equips students with specialized knowledge in the rapidly evolving field of blockchain technology.

This program delves into blockchain platforms, such as Ethereum, that foster transparency and trust in complex multiparty relationships, impacting industries from finance to healthcare. Students will explore crypto-engineering techniques that establish digital trust, facilitating secure transactions.

Located in Arlington, VA, this program connects students with leading-edge companies and offers access to Northeastern’s extensive global network, setting them up for success in an expanding market.
8xgt:
The Full-Time MS in Finance/MBA at D’Amore-McKim will prepare students for the evolving future of the finance industry with specialized dual expertise in finance and business-in less time than it would take to earn two degrees separately.

Advances in technology are revolutionizing how we create wealth and transact financial business. This rapid change creates a strong demand for leaders with the finance knowledge, business acumen, and interdisciplinary skills to solve complex problems.

Students will develop deep knowledge of core finance and business concepts along with an additional area of specialty to give them a rich background for decision-making. Throughout this program, students will have opportunities for transformational experiences that amplify their learning-including Northeastern’s one-of-a-kind corporate residency, where they will earn a salary as a valued team member at a leading financial firm.
